claim: The sample demo never changes your real record
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real medication, edit the demo, return to the real record, and assert only the real medication remains

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context visits /privacy then /demo; establish service-worker control, set the context offline, reload a cache-busted /demo URL, and assert the sample handoff remains

claim: Medication records stay in this browser; the app creates no account and uses no analytics or third-party runtime scripts
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record a dose and create a QR while intercepting every request; assert no request leaves the product origin and no account control exists
fresh /demo context; choose clear export and assert two downloads, the CSV header, and a Metformin row

claim: Encrypts an optional JSON backup locally with AES-GCM; it cannot be opened without its passphrase
sandbox: fresh /demo context; export with a passphrase, assert an AES-GCM parcel, then assert import with a wrong passphrase fails

claim: Creates a local QR handoff that stays until it is hidden or the page closes
sandbox: fresh /demo context; create and decode a browser data:image/png QR; assert every dose medicationId is present in the regimen, then hide it
fresh /demo context; invoke print, switch to print media, and assert the handoff remains while tools are hidden

claim: Printing, QR handoffs, and exports are free
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert all three tools are enabled and no checkout link exists

claim: Keeps a current medication list with amounts, directions, and times
sandbox: fresh real-record context; save a medication and assert its amount, direction, and schedule are rendered after reload

claim: Records a dose state and optional caregiver note
sandbox: fresh real-record context; mark a scheduled medication Held with a note and assert both are rendered after reload

claim: Stores the real record in IndexedDB in your browser
sandbox: fresh real-record context; save a medication, reload, and assert the medication remains

claim: Records regimen changes in the handoff history
sandbox: fresh real-record context; change a medication amount and time, then assert the history names both the prior and new regimen
